entities.name: Vedalken
entities.description: A tall, thin, hairless, blue-skinned humanoid race of exceptional mental acumen, natural artificers and mages, found on many planes.

entities.name: Esper
entities.description: The Alaran shard where vedalken make up a large majority of the sentient population and lead magical advancement and the use of etherium.

entities.name: Naya
entities.description: The verdant jungle shard of Alara where some vedalken heretics from Esper migrated.

entities.name: Alara
entities.description: The broken plane, later reborn, where vedalken live in Esper and Naya.

entities.name: Avishkar
entities.description: The plane where vedalken organize themselves into clades.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: The plane where vedalken were mutated by the mycosynth's vapor and later overtaken by Phyrexia.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The plane where vedalken associate with the Simic Combine and Azorius Senate.

entities.name: Lumengrid
entities.description: The center of vedalken culture on Mirrodin, overtaken by Jin-Gitaxias's forces.

entities.name: Neurok
entities.description: Tribes on the shores of the Quicksilver Sea enslaved by the vedalken, who later forced cooperation after revolts.

entities.name: Synod
entities.description: The body that ruled the vedalken on Mirrodin, considering themselves servants of Memnarch.

entities.name: Memnarch
entities.description: Mirrodin's guardian, whom the Synod served and whose fall forced the vedalken to reorganize.

entities.name: Jin-Gitaxias
entities.description: The Phyrexian praetor whose forces overtook Lumengrid and turned conquered vedalken into a living research library.

entities.name: Progress Engine
entities.description: The Phyrexian machine used with Jin-Gitaxias to convert and co-opt the vedalken.

entities.name: Simic Combine
entities.description: A Ravnican guild closely associated with vedalken.

entities.name: Azorius Senate
entities.description: A Ravnican guild closely associated with vedalken.

events.summary: After the Shards of Alara realigned, some vedalken migrated from Esper to Naya.
events.quote: some migrated to Naya after the Shards of Alara realigned

events.summary: After Alara was reborn, vedalken heretics from Esper reject etherium for nature in the jungles of Naya.
events.quote: they rejected the cold clutch of etherium in favor of the warm embrace of nature

events.summary: On Mirrodin, the mycosynth's vapor mutates the vedalken, who develop four arms and gills.
events.quote: the mycosynth created a vapor that induced mutations in the vedalken

events.summary: After Memnarch's fall, the Synod reorganizes the vedalken into sanctives, and Neurok revolts force cooperation.
events.quote: revolts from the Neurok forced the two races into a state of cooperation rather than subservience

events.summary: When New Phyrexia rises, Jin-Gitaxias overtakes Lumengrid and turns conquered vedalken into a research library.
events.quote: Lumengrid was overtaken by the forces of Jin-Gitaxias

relations.note: Ruled over an empire that enslaved them.
relations.quote: an empire that enslaved the Neurok tribes
who considered themselves servants of Mirrodin's guardian, Memnarch

relations.note: Conquered Lumengrid and turned vedalken into a research library.
relations.quote: Jin-Gitaxias and the Progress Engine turned the conquered Vedalken into a living research library
